content: अनेक {%a.%} .²1 Not one; more than one, many; अनेकपितृकाणां तु पितृतो भागकल्पना <ls>Y. 2. 120</ls>, अनेकराजन्यरथाश्वसंकुलम् <ls>Ki. 1. 16</ls>; several, various; तथात्मैकोऽप्यनेकश्च <ls>Y. 3. 144</ls>. .²2 Separated; divided; <ab>oft.</ab> in <ab>comp.</ab>; ˚आकार having many shapes or forms; diverse, multiform; ˚कालम् - वारम् several times, many a time and <ab>oft.</ab>; ˚भार्य having more wives than one.
